description.value: Pho 777 is a Vietnamese restaurant on Fraser Highway in central Langley serving pho and a full menu of Vietnamese cuisine for dine-in, takeout, and delivery. It also offers catering, banquet services, and explicitly advertises tourist group meals, suggesting it can accommodate larger cycling groups. Its location on Fraser Hwy at 206 Street puts it on a main arterial through Langley convenient to cyclists passing through.
